name: Uso ni Somatta Koi o Shiyou ka.
original_name: 嘘に染まった恋をしようか。
source:
The story of one brother, erasing the memories of his younger brothers for the success of fulfilling his own selfish desires...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ199516.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一个关于某位兄长为了满足一己私欲，不惜抹去弟弟们的记忆的故事……

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ199516.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
